exposure: Systemic inflammation indices (SII, SIRI, NLR, PIV)
cohort: The study included 75 pregnant women with endometriosis confirmed at cesarean sections, with clinical and obstetric data compared to hospital-wide cesarean section data from the same period.
finding: While pregnant women with endometriosis had a significantly higher incidence of preterm birth (20%) compared to other women delivering by cesarean section (11.4%), systemic inflammation indices measured shortly before delivery were not associated with preterm birth in the endometriosis cohort.
cross-section timing: Systemic inflammation indices were calculated from peripheral blood tests taken shortly before delivery.
